answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, tied to one verified credential issued once per human operator. A newcomer starts with zero trust and must complete small audited jobs, like a quill signing each delivery, while peers watch for copied work. When a raven-like swarm of clones appears, their identical stake patterns and shared funding trail expose the spiral of fake identities, and slashing burns the whole cluster bonds at once, so sybils cost more than they earn.
